film.title: From Soil to Silicon
film.intent: Honor family sacrifice and inspire hope through education and agricultural technology

visual_style.description: Cinematic realism, natural lighting, subtle film grain, authentic Ethiopian rural environments, realistic anatomy and culturally appropriate clothing
visual_style.composition: Landscape composition with essential subjects inside the central vertical safe area. No text, captions or watermarks requested in generated imagery.

characters.description: A fictional Ethiopian male child, exactly seven years old. Clearly recognizable as a small elementary-school-aged child. Short stature, small frame, narrow shoulders, round youthful face, soft cheeks, small jaw, large expressive brown eyes, dark brown skin, short tightly curled black hair. Wearing a faded beige shirt and simple brown trousers. Innocent, curious and hardworking appearance. Authentic rural Ethiopian childhood.

A fictional sixteen-year-old Ethiopian male high school student in late adolescence. Tall, approximately 175 cm, with a lean athletic physique developed through years of agricultural labor. Long limbs, moderately broad shoulders, defined cheekbones, developing masculine jawline, mature adolescent facial proportions, dark brown skin, expressive brown eyes and short tightly curled black hair. Clean-shaven face. Wearing a simple button-up shirt and carrying a worn school backpack. He has the physical appearance of an older high school student approaching adulthood, not a prepubescent child. Confident, independent and determined expression.

A fictional Ethiopian twenty-two-year-old adult man. Clearly a fully grown young adult with a strong masculine appearance, tall stature, athletic naturally muscular build, broad shoulders, strong neck, well-defined masculine jawline, mature angular facial structure, expressive brown eyes, dark brown skin and short tightly curled black hair. Subtle natural facial stubble. Confident, intelligent and physically mature. Wearing fitted but modest casual university clothing. Must unmistakably look like a twenty-two-year-old adult man, not a teenage boy or child.
Fictional Ethiopian farming mother, dark brown skin, kind expressive face, practical modest clothing, traditional light cotton headscarf, hardworking and dignified appearance

narration.style: Deep, resonant masculine voice with a rich, warm texture. Cinematic autobiographical documentary narration. Speak as a mature Ethiopian man reflecting on his childhood memories. Use natural native Amharic pronunciation, measured pacing, gentle emotional emphasis, and meaningful pauses. Sound intimate, nostalgic, sincere and thoughtful. Avoid robotic delivery, exaggerated acting, newsreader intonation and excessive speed.

music.prompt: Original Ethiopian-inspired cinematic instrumental score with gentle krar plucked strings, expressive masenqo textures, subtle percussion, spacious arrangement and a gradual emotional transition from nostalgia to hope

shots.reason: Establish the rural environment where the story began
shots.image_prompt: Wide establishing shot of a quiet Ethiopian farming village at sunrise, fields of green teff and wheat, modest rural houses, distant hills, soft golden morning light, peaceful but grounded atmosphere
shots.motion_prompt: Slow camera push forward, gentle wind moving the crops, subtle morning atmosphere
shots.narration_text: የእኔ ታሪክ የጀመረው በኢትዮጵያ ገጠር፣ በአንዲት ትንሽ የገበሬዎች መንደር ነው።
shots.subtitle_en: My story began in a small farming village in rural Ethiopia.

shots.reason: Introduce the protagonist and his relationship with his mother
shots.image_prompt: Medium-wide rear three-quarter cinematic shot of a small seven-year-old Ethiopian boy walking beside his adult mother toward green farmland. The child is visibly much shorter and smaller than his mother, with narrow shoulders and a small childhood frame. Early morning sunlight, quiet intimate atmosphere, both subjects centrally composed.
shots.motion_prompt: Mother and child walk slowly forward, clothing moves gently in the breeze, camera follows from behind
shots.narration_text: ገና የሰባት ዓመት ልጅ ሳለሁ፣ ከእናቴ ጋር በእርሻ ላይ ረጅም ቀናትን አሳልፍ ነበር።
shots.subtitle_en: At just seven years old, I spent long days working beside my mother in the fields.

shots.reason: Show the demanding manual agricultural labor that inspired the future goal
shots.image_prompt: Intimate close-up of a seven-year-old child's small hands and an adult woman's larger hands manually separating weeds from young teff plants. Clear visible difference in hand size. Rich dark soil, realistic agricultural detail, afternoon sunlight and evidence of hard work.
shots.motion_prompt: Hands gently remove a single weed from the soil, nearby crops sway slightly, camera remains steady
shots.narration_text: በትምህርት እረፍት ጊዜ አረም እናርም፣ ጤፍና ስንዴም እናጭድ ነበር። ሥራው እጅግ አድካሚ ነበር።
shots.subtitle_en: During school breaks, we pulled weeds and harvested teff and wheat. The work was exhausting.

shots.reason: Contrast agricultural hardship with the child's determination to learn
shots.image_prompt: A small seven-year-old Ethiopian schoolboy studying from a worn notebook inside a modest rural home. Clearly a young child, round face, small body, narrow shoulders, innocent focused expression. Warm evening light across his face and notebook.
shots.motion_prompt: The boy slowly turns a notebook page, subtle breathing, gentle camera push toward the notebook
shots.narration_text: ሕይወታችን ቀላል ባይሆንም፣ ትምህርት የወደፊት ሕይወታችንን ሊለውጥ እንደሚችል አምን ነበር።
shots.subtitle_en: Life was not easy, but I believed education could change our future.

shots.reason: Honor the mother's sacrifices and introduce the emotional turning point
shots.image_prompt: Emotional medium shot of an Ethiopian farming mother standing beside her sixteen-year-old teenage son outside their modest rural home. The son is now tall and lean, noticeably older than the child in earlier scenes, with developed adolescent shoulders and longer facial proportions. He carries schoolbooks. His mother looks proud and hopeful. Natural warm daylight.
shots.motion_prompt: Mother gently places a hand on her son's shoulder, subtle natural facial expression, steady camera
shots.narration_text: በስምንተኛ ክፍል ብሔራዊ ፈተና ከትምህርት ቤቴ አንደኛ ስወጣ፣ እናቴ ትምህርቴን እንድቀጥል የበለጠ መሥዋዕትነት ከፈለች።
shots.subtitle_en: When I ranked first in my school in the Grade 8 national exam, my mother sacrificed even more so I could continue studying.

shots.reason: Represent the transition from childhood to independent education
shots.image_prompt: Wide cinematic full-body rear three-quarter view of a tall sixteen-year-old Ethiopian teenage male student carrying a worn backpack along a rural dirt road. Lean adolescent physique, long legs and youthful shoulders. Village and fields behind him, distant hills ahead, soft morning sunlight. Central composition.
shots.motion_prompt: The student walks slowly away from the village, camera follows gently from behind
shots.narration_text: በአሥራ ስድስት ዓመቴ ለትምህርት ከመንደሬ ወጣሁ። በእረፍት ጊዜ ግን ወደ እርሻችን እመለስ ነበር።
shots.subtitle_en: At sixteen, I left my village to study. But during school breaks, I always returned to our farm.

shots.reason: Introduce the discovery of computer science and artificial intelligence
shots.image_prompt: A physically mature twenty-two-year-old Ethiopian man working at a desktop computer in a university computer laboratory in Addis Ababa. Masculine angular face, strong jawline, subtle facial stubble, broad shoulders and athletic adult physique. Confident and focused expression. Medium waist-up composition, soft screen illumination, realistic academic environment.
shots.motion_prompt: Student types gently and looks thoughtfully at the computer screen, subtle camera push inward
shots.narration_text: በአዲስ አበባ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ኮምፒውተርን፣ ፕሮግራሚንግንና ሰው ሠራሽ አስተውሎትን ተዋወቅሁ።
shots.subtitle_en: At Addis Ababa University, I discovered computers, programming and artificial intelligence.

shots.reason: Connect artificial intelligence to the agricultural problem experienced in childhood
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic macro view of cultivated green crop seedlings growing alongside distinct weeds in Ethiopian farmland, individual plants clearly visible, subtle conceptual computer vision outlines around selected plants, no readable text, imagined technological perspective
shots.motion_prompt: Slow camera movement across the plants, gentle leaf motion, subtle stable visual detection outlines
shots.narration_text: ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ማሳዎቻችንን በተለየ መንገድ ማየት ጀመርሁ። ቴክኖሎጂ አረምን ከሰብል ሊለይ ይችላል።
shots.subtitle_en: For the first time, I saw our fields differently. Technology could distinguish weeds from crops.

shots.reason: Illustrate the protagonist's imagined future for smallholder agriculture
shots.image_prompt: Imagined future of Ethiopian smallholder agriculture, a compact practical agricultural robot designed for uneven rural farmland, moving between green crop rows, realistic engineering design, hopeful natural sunlight, conceptual future visualization
shots.motion_prompt: Small agricultural robot moves slowly along one crop row, gentle camera tracking, nearby leaves sway naturally
shots.narration_text: አረም የሚለዩና ሰብል ለማጨድ የሚያግዙ ማሽኖች፣ የገበሬዎችን ድካም ሲቀንሱ ማሰብ ጀመርሁ።
shots.subtitle_en: I imagined machines identifying weeds, helping harvest crops and reducing farmers' exhausting labor.

shots.reason: Return visually to the protagonist's roots and conclude with hope
shots.image_prompt: Powerful cinematic rear three-quarter view of a strong twenty-two-year-old Ethiopian adult man standing confidently overlooking the rural farmland where his childhood began. Tall athletic physique, broad masculine shoulders, strong arms and upright posture. Show part of his mature facial profile. Golden sunset, green fields extending toward distant hills. Quiet hopeful atmosphere, centered subject, emotionally powerful closing composition.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow camera pull backward revealing the surrounding fields, gentle wind in the crops, warm sunset light
shots.narration_text: ጉዞዬ የጀመረው ከአፈር ነው። ሕልሜም በቴክኖሎጂ የቀጣዩን ትውልድ ጉዞ ቀላል ማድረግ ነው።
shots.subtitle_en: My journey began in the soil. My dream is to use technology to make the next generation's journey easier.
